business_problem: Santander aimed to move its AI-first strategy into measurable execution across banking operations, customer service, risk management, growth, and employee workflows, while extending practical AI access across the group.
solution_summary: Banco Santander applies AI across banking operations and employee workflows. More than 280 process automation agents in production help automate manual tasks and support end-to-end workflows in credit, fraud, KYC and operations. AI is used for Brazilian card-fraud claims, UK voice-channel card queries, Spanish onboarding credit-card eligibility and Openbank anti-money-laundering alerts. Microsoft Copilot, including Microsoft 365 Copilot experiences, supports employee productivity; Santander also uses a secure multi-provider approach for specialized capabilities, naming OpenAI’s ChatGPT, Anthropic’s Claude and Google’s Gemini. AI agents support software development, while Getnet applies AI to cross-border payment experiences. The source describes secure environments and ethical, legal, cybersecurity and risk frameworks, but does not specify data ingestion, model-training, storage or serving architecture.
